_format: Narrative templates rendered into the lore stream. Per-card prose lives in approaches.json; per-intent prose lives in intents.json; per-patient prose lives in patients.json. This file is for: intake event lines, protagonist's own file (filled in over the run), category reveal text, scar acquisition text, finale text.

events.intake_open: I open the file. {patient} is across the desk.
events.intake_start_turn: Turn {turn}. The pen is in my hand.
events.intent_handled: I had the page ready for it.
events.intent_taken: I take it on the page.
events.fragment_revealed: Another line settles into the file.
events.category_revealed: The ward is **{category}**. I knew before I knew.
events.patient_named: I write the name across the top. The file ~~closes~~ rests.
events.patient_lost: !!The patient finishes the page in my hand.!! I take what they leave.
events.composure_lost: The room is louder than I am. I sit back.
events.scar_taken: I will carry it. It has been written into me as well.
events.intake_timeup: The intake ran its hour. !!Whatever was unsaid stays.!!
events.no_pages: I have nothing left to write with this turn.

categoryRevealed.mourner: They are grieving. The file fills when they speak the name.
categoryRevealed.visitor: They are not who they were. The file fills when I do what they do.
categoryRevealed.tenant: Something is in them. The file fills when I keep it still.
categoryRevealed.witness: They have seen the room. The file fills if I do not look at the corner.
categoryRevealed.stranger: They are between things. The file fills when I keep their rhythm.

default: The corridor narrows past the threshold. I count the doors.
There is no daylight at this level. The lamps do not flicker. There is no reason to flicker.
I hear another intake further down. I keep my pace.
I do not know how I came to be the one with the pen.
after_loss: The room I just left is quieter than it should be. I do not look back.
The scar arrived before I did. The page accepted it.
Staff pass me. They do not ~~know~~ stop me.
after_win: The page I just closed sits in the file. The file is heavier by an inch.
I have begun to know what I am doing. The certainty is the trouble.
An orderly nods. They do not ask after me.

boon.intro: Between intakes, I write what I am learning. One method goes in. Some leave with me.
boon.skip: I take nothing in. The page is full enough.

intro: I found the address on a card I do not remember writing. The road ended at the building.
The nurse opened the door before I knocked. She said they were expecting me.
She handed me a file. She said it had been waiting.
Ten descents. One intake at a time. !!The door at the top is locked from this side.!!
admission.method_pick: She asks what I ~~know how to do~~ start with. I choose one method. The others I will learn.
admission.begin: I take the file. The desk on the first floor is already occupied.

0: Arrived at the front entrance unaccompanied. No identification provided.
Vitals normal. Responds to questions. !!Does not remember the address.!!
1: Has been observed reading other patients' files. Staff have not interrupted.
2: Refers to the south corridor as familiar. Has not been there.
3: Has begun to dress in staff hand. The staff handbook is missing a chapter.
4: Asked about [[6]]. Did not seem to need an answer.
5: Has stopped using room 0413 to sleep. !!Sleeps where the file is.!!
6: Asked about the room they were admitted with. There is no such room. !!There never was.!!
7: Has begun to **answer** for other patients at intake. Their files are filling faster.
8: Has stopped responding to designation 0413. Responds to **0412**.
9: The room marked 0413 is now vacant again. !!Vacant.!!

finale.open: The tenth desk. The chair across from me is occupied. The file in front of me is mine.
finale.win: I close my own file. ~~The hand is mine.~~ The hand is the one signing me out.
finale.lose: The pen will not stay in my hand. The file fills in around me. !!I am admitted again.!!

endings.run_completed: The door at the top opens onto the road. The road is paved this time. !!The car keys are in my hand.!!
endings.run_failed: The file closes. Another patient is signed in. !!0413 was already taken.!!
endings.new_run: Another file is opened at the desk. The handwriting is mine. ~~It is also.~~ It is also someone else's.
